Data Analyst
Tidewater Logistics, Inc.
Savannah, GA

Tidewater Logistics moves freight for retailers across the Southeast. The analytics team turns shipment data into reports that dispatchers and executives use every day.

In this role
- Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau and Power BI
- Pull data from SQL Server and Snowflake
- Present findings to operations leaders each month

Minimum qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field
- 2+ years of SQL
- Advanced Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables
- Experience with Tableau or Power BI
- Strong attention to detail and time management

Bonus
- Python or R for analysis
- Experience with Salesforce data

This position is on-site at our Savannah office.
